ei.title: Bacon's Bee Metaphor for Scientific Inquiry
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The philosopher and statesman Francis Bacon couched the efforts of his peers to understand the world, whether it is the workings of an organ or movements of the heavens, in terms of the spiders and the ants, where the former use reason and the latter rely on experiment. Importantly, Bacon realised that a blend of both skills — as performed by the bees — was necessary for what today we call science: like these busy little insects, worker scientists harvest data from experiments so that their minds can transform them into fruitful information. In his evocative writing, one can see an outline of how science still works: reason guides experiment, which paves the way for new reasoning and then new experiments. With his metaphor of the bee, Bacon had rejected the approaches of the ant, which depended on radical empiricism (data without reason), and of the spider, which relied on rationalism (reason without data), in his quest for knowledge.

questions.passage: The philosopher and statesman Francis Bacon ①<u>couched</u> the efforts of his peers to understand the world, whether it is the workings of an organ or movements of the heavens, in terms of the spiders and the ants, ②<u>which</u> the former use reason and the latter rely on experiment. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①couched(과거형→적절) ②which(←where 관계부사) ③performed(과거분사→적절) ④necessary(형용사→적절)
det.analysis:
① couched: Francis Bacon couched the efforts → 타동사 과거형, 적절
② which: 'the spiders and the ants, where the former use reason' — 관계사절 안이 완전한 문장(S+V)이므로 관계부사 where 필요. which는 대명사로 절 내 주어나 목적어 역할을 해야 하나 여기서 부적절 ←정답
③ performed: as performed by the bees (수동 분사구) → 적절
④ necessary: was necessary (보어 형용사) → 적절
det.tip: 관계부사 where → 뒤 절이 완전한 문장(S+V 갖춤)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①realised(동사→적절) ②necessary(형용사→적절) ③harvest(동사→적절) ④fruitfully(←fruitful 형용사)
det.analysis:
① realised: Bacon realised that → 동사 과거형, 적절
② necessary: was necessary → 보어 형용사, 적절
③ harvest: worker scientists harvest data → 서술어 동사, 적절
④ fruitfully: transform them into ______ information — information(명사)을 수식해야 하므로 형용사 fruitful이 필요. 부사 fruitfully는 명사 수식 불가 ←정답

questions.passage: The philosopher and statesman Francis Bacon couched the efforts of his peers to understand the world, whether it is the workings of an organ or movements of the heavens, in terms of the spiders and the ants, where the former use reason and the latter rely on experiment. Importantly, Bacon realised that a blend of both skills — as performed by the bees — was necessary for what today we call science: like these busy little insects, worker scientists harvest data from experiments ①<u>in order</u> their minds ②<u>can</u> transform them into fruitful information. In his evocative writing, one can see an outline of how science still works: reason guides experiment, which paves the way for new reasoning and then new experiments. With his metaphor of the bee, Bacon had rejected the approaches of the ant, which ③<u>depended</u> on radical empiricism (data without reason), and of the spider, which ④<u>relied</u> on rationalism (reason without data), in his quest for knowledge.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①in order(←so that 접속사) ②can(조동사→적절) ③depended(과거형→적절) ④relied(과거형→적절)
det.analysis:
① in order: 'so that their minds can transform them' — so that + S + V (목적의 부사절). in order는 to부정사와 결합(in order to V)하며 that절 불가 ←정답
② can: so that their minds can transform → 조동사 can, 적절
③ depended: which depended on radical empiricism → 과거형, 적절
④ relied: which relied on rationalism → 과거형, 적절
det.tip: in order to V vs so that S + V — 뒤 구조가 다름

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①statesman(정치가) ②blend(혼합) ③useless(쓸모없는←fruitful) ④guides(안내하다)
det.analysis:
① statesman: 철학자이자 정치가인 베이컨 → 적절
② blend: 두 기술의 혼합이 필요하다 → 적절
③ useless: 마음이 데이터를 '쓸모없는' 정보로 변환한다 → 유익한(fruitful)이어야 맥락 자연스러움 ←정답
④ guides: 이성이 실험을 안내한다 → 적절
det.tip: fruitful(유익한) ↔ useless(쓸모없는)

det.korean: ①evocative(연상적인) ②outline(개요) ③paves(길을 닦다) ④rejection(거부←quest 탐구)
